Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy for Summit Ski Bike Rentals

Privacy Policy for the Summit Archive

Last updated: November 7, 2026

Summit Ski & Bike no longer operates rentals. This website preserves historical information and photographs. It does not accept bookings, payments, or newsletter subscriptions.

Information in contact messages

When you use the contact form, we collect your name, email address, phone number, selected topic, and message so we can respond. Please do not include payment details or other sensitive information that is not needed for your question.

Storage, delivery, and security

Contact messages are stored privately in Neon Postgres and sent through Resend to the owner and to the email address you provide. Vercel hosts the website and form functions. Cloudflare Turnstile checks submissions for automated abuse, and Cloudflare Email Routing forwards messages sent to info@summitskibike.com to the owner's Gmail inbox.

The form stores a salted hash derived from the request IP address for rate limiting. Hosting, email, and security providers may also process connection information such as IP addresses, browser information, and delivery logs under their own policies. The public website does not expose an inquiry list or your messages.

How information is used

Messages are used to respond to inquiries and protect the form from abuse. A confirmation email is a copy of your inquiry; it is not a reservation confirmation or a marketing subscription. We do not sell your contact details.

Retention and requests

Messages and historical inquiry exports remain stored until removed by the owner. You may contact summitskibike@gmail.com to request access, correction, or deletion of your message. Service providers may retain operational logs or backups under their own retention policies.

Videos and external websites

YouTube videos load in a privacy-enhanced player when you choose to play them. YouTube and other linked websites have their own privacy policies and may process connection information or use browser storage. Turnstile may also use browser signals or storage for security verification.

Contact
